annotations.title: Hold a time and fix the price

description: Reserves the chosen time, seats or units for 10 minutes and fixes the price. Pass `start` (slots), `session_id` (sessions) or `from`+`to` (rentals). Then show the user time, price and cancellation policy and ask for an explicit yes before create_booking.

from.description: Rental pickup. ISO 8601. With an offset it is absolute; without an offset it is local time of the business (e.g. 2026-09-18T15:00).

start.description: Slot start. ISO 8601. With an offset it is absolute; without an offset it is local time of the business (e.g. 2026-09-18T15:00).

to.description: Rental return. ISO 8601. With an offset it is absolute; without an offset it is local time of the business (e.g. 2026-09-18T15:00).

name: create_hold
title: Hold a time and fix the price
